steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Problem questions present a factual scenario and ask you to advise on the legal position — they test your ability to apply law to facts, not just recall legal rules | Key Fact: The ILAC method provides a clear structure: Issue (identify the legal question), Law (state the relevant legal rules), Application (apply the law to the facts), Conclusion (state the likely outcome) | Key Fact: Identify all the legal issues in the scenario — there are usually multiple issues, such as actus reus, mens rea and any defences in a criminal problem | Key Fact: State the law accurately — name the relevant statute or case, define the legal principle precisely and set out the elements that must be proved
